E3.title: E3 optimizer x init x schedule comparison (MNIST MLP)
notes: Test accuracy on 2,000 held-out MNIST test images after the fixed step budget.
Steps-to-target: first step where the EMA(0.9) training loss <= 0.3; censored runs count as budget + 1.
One standard LR per optimizer, not tuned per cell.

A contrast is 'separated' only if both the pair-level paired-bootstrap CI and the seed-clustered CI (bootstrap over the 5 per-seed mean differences) exclude zero. With 5 seeds the exact sign-flip test cannot go below p = 0.0625; it is reported for transparency.
